theme: The ROI of Getting People Out of the Office

linkedin.text: Every HR and sales leader we work with asks the same question before an incentive trip: how do we justify this to the CFO? Here's the answer we've seen work across 16 years and 1,500+ events — stop framing it as a reward and start framing it as a performance lever. Incentive travel that's designed with business goals baked in — territory targets, product knowledge, cross-team alignment — pays for itself in ways that show up in Q-over-Q numbers. We've built that case for companies across 130+ destinations. If you're building it for yours, let's talk. DM me directly.

instagram.text: 130+ destinations. 25,000+ participants. One consistent truth: the best-performing sales teams aren't just trained — they're taken somewhere worth remembering. What's on your incentive travel shortlist for next year? Tell us below. #CorpEventsTLV #IncentiveTravelIL #HapakotIsrael

facebook.text: Here's something we've seen play out across 1,500+ events: the team that travels together closes more deals together. Not because of the destination — though 130+ of them have been pretty spectacular — but because shared experience builds the kind of trust that no Zoom call can manufacture. If you're planning next year's incentive trip and want to talk strategy before you talk budget, drop a comment or send us a message.
